description: Injected taps page through Windows and focus Terminal, then Monitor, using the persistent touch controls.
provenance_note: Operator-declared metadata does not prove that footage shows a real touch.

site_assets.video_transform: 180 degree rotation and full-to-limited range conversion; original camera clip retained
site_assets.screenshot_source: grim on the physical board, transferred over serial

review.video_probe: H.264, yuv420p, limited range, 1920x1080, 28.000 seconds, 840 frames
review.visual_review: Reviewed camera frames near 2, 8, 14, and 22 seconds. The Windows control, terminal, and Monitor views are visible on the portrait panel; camera glare and the oblique view soften text. The Monitor presentation is narrow and clipped, so it is retained as diagnostic evidence and not claimed as polished site presentation.
review.interaction_state: Injected uinput taps opened Windows and focused Terminal, then selected Monitor; no physical-touch claim is made.
